observed_failure: Numeric value mismatch for object Bodies: 'Sum: 6.06775878802135438e+00' vs 'Sum: 4.09517095286604516e+01'
finding: The fused kernel loads old positions from the global Body array into shared tiles and eventually overwrites the same global bodies with updated positions. The barriers are block-local only; an earlier-finishing block can overwrite a body before another block has loaded its old position. The partial final block exposes this pre-existing cross-block read/write race.
interpretation: Exclusive execution and internal finite-value validation succeed, but independent numerical validation fails. Retain failed external validation without retry or source changes.
investigation: Static source inspection and retained exclusive numerical failure; no new program execution.
